starts.why: Sights: just inside Bukchon's gate, on the open yard by the shops, facing up into the village: hanok roofs and villagers on the first screen, room for the camera, and Anguk Station outside the gate for the first trip to Seongsu.
Shopping and dressing up: beside the square guide on Seongsu Square, the old start, with the shops, hair salons and clothes around it.
An outing: on Ttukseom Han River Park's bank (moved up when the Han got its real width), facing the river (duck boats, fishing, the drone show).
A quiet walk: in Seoul Forest at the south end of Metasequoia Avenue, looking up the tree-lined walk, near the butterfly greenhouse and the flower gardens.

anchor.why: No nudge: the gate on its real spot and the palace on its real ground (scripts/build-gyeongbokgung.mjs). Jong-ro, the map's south edge, is 12 m south of its real line: Cheonggyecheon (game width) needs the room.

6 m north of its spot, so Jongno runs on straight from Gwanghwamun's Jong-ro (z -725, 6-12 m south of the real line, as Cheonggyecheon at game width needs the room); the gate stands behind Jongmyo Square on Jongno's north side.

links.note: Jong-ro from Heunginjimun's island east to Dongmyo.
Teheran-ro turns into Olympic-ro, crosses Tancheon on Samseong Bridge (in Samseong's map) and runs on east-north-east to Songpa's Olympic-ro, towards Jamsil Station.
Olympic-ro runs east from Jamsil Station (Songpa) to Mongchontoseong Station at Olympic Park's corner, on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap).

From the south end of Itaewon's Noksapyeong-daero through Yongsan Park, onto Banpo Bridge's line to the north end of Jamsu Bridge (the low deck under it), which crosses to Banpo-Jamwon Han River Park. On the real roads at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-banpo.mjs).
Achasan-ro runs on east from Seongsu to Neungdong-ro by Konkuk University Station.
Neungdong-ro runs north-north-east from Achasan-ro to Children's Grand Park Station and the park's main gate, on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap).
From the north end of Ogansugyo Bridge (Cheonggyecheon-ro's north road) up to Heunginjimun's island, on Jangchungdan-ro's line.

Toegye-ro starts at Sungnyemun and runs east past Myeongdong and Namsangol to Changgyeonggung-ro, where Euljiro's map takes it on to DDP, on its real line (OpenStreetMap, scripts/data/euljiro-osm.json).
From Sungnyemun north past City Hall to Sejong-daero by Cheonggye Plaza (the Gyeongbokgung map's), on its real line (OpenStreetMap).
Eulji-ro from Sejong-daero (by City Hall) east to Changgyeonggung-ro, where Euljiro's map takes it on to DDP, on its real line (OpenStreetMap).
Changgyeonggung-ro on north from Baeogae Bridge (Cheonggyecheon-ro's north road) to Jongno, on its real line (OpenStreetMap); south of the stream it is Euljiro's.
Toegye-ro east from Euljiro's district past Sindang to Wangsimni-ro (to Seongsu).
From Seongsu north-west to the east end of Cheonggyecheon (Hwanghakgyo).
From Jongno in front of Jongmyo Square south between the buildings to Cheonggyecheon-ro at Gwansugyo Bridge.

Sowol-ro round Namsan's west side: from Itaewon's Sowol-ro (Haebangchon) north to the road round Sungnyemun, where Toegye-ro starts, on its real line (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-itaewon.mjs). Itaewon and Banpo no longer go round through Seongsu to reach Jung-gu and Jongno.
Sopa-ro, the road up past the Namsan cable car's lower station, from Toegye-ro by Myeongdong round to Sowol-ro, on its real line (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-namsan.mjs).
Namdaemun-ro's last few metres from Myeongdong's map to the north-east corner of Sungnyemun's ring road, on its real line (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-myeongdong.mjs).
From the south end of Hongdae's Wausan-ro (Sangsu Station, on Dongmak-ro) down to the Han River Bike Path, where Seogang Bridge starts for Yeouido.

The north-bank Han River bike path on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap cycleways, scripts/build-bike-paths.mjs): from Mangwon Han River Park's path past the north ends of Seogang Bridge and Jamsu Bridge to Seongsu's Han River Path.

The south-bank Han River bike path on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-bike-paths.mjs): from Yeouido Han River Park's path over the Saetgang's mouth east through Dongjak and Seocho to Banpo-Jamwon park's river path. Open through the closed land.

The south-bank Han River bike path on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-bike-paths.mjs): from Banpo-Jamwon park east past Apgujeong and Cheongdam, over Tancheon's mouth, to Jamsil Bridge. Open through the closed land. Why off the real line: by Apgujeong (x -155..-20) Seongsu's river cuts the real bank straight, so the path keeps up to 20 m south of its real line there.

The north-bank Han River bike path on its real line at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap, scripts/build-bike-paths.mjs) from the east end of Seongsu's Han River Path to Jamsil Bridge's north end. Why off the real line: Ttukseom Han River Park stands on a straight bank up to 40 m north of the real one, so the path leaves the park's path and meets its real line by x 520.

water.note: Han River from Mangwon Han River Park east to just west of Banpo Bridge, on its real banks; its south bank by the island is Yeouido's real north shore (scripts/build-yeouido.mjs writes this). Its blocker has a gap for Seogang Bridge.
Han River from west of Banpo Bridge north-east to Seongsu (Ttukseom), on its real banks at 1/4 (scripts/han-bank.mjs, OpenStreetMap). Its blocker has a gap for Jamsu Bridge.

Han River from Seongsu east past Jamsil Bridge to Songpa: the real banks at 1/4 (OpenStreetMap); from x 520 to Jamsil Bridge the north bank is drawn 8 m off the real bike path, eased onto it from Seongsu's straight bank (scripts/bike-bank.mjs, scripts/build-bike-paths.mjs). Its blockers leave a gap for Jamsil Bridge (Songpa-daero).

subway.note: Underground stations. Add one by adding an entry to stations. exits[].at is a spot on the world map (Seongsu coordinates; other districts include their offset), ry the direction the stairs go down (radians). Move exits freely: the hole, walls and canopy follow.

stations.note: At the Achasan-ro / Seongsui-ro crossing (zone A-6). The real Seongsu Station is elevated; in the game you go down to its hall. Its four exits are where OpenStreetMap has them (1 and 2 north of Achasan-ro, 3 and 4 south; 1 and 4 west, 2 and 3 by Seongsui-ro), moved only onto the sidewalk: the game's roads are wider than 1/4, so 2 and 3 sit 11-13 m west of their real spots, off Seongsui-ro.

On Wangsimni-ro at Seoul Forest's east edge, north of Ttukseom-ro (its real place): both exits on the forest side of the road, at the real exits 1 and 2's height on Wangsimni-ro (they are really just across it, 12-13 m east). No line name or code on purpose: the game has no transfers, so stations are not split by line.
On Yulgok-ro at the foot of Bukchon-ro. Exit 2 is on the Bukchon side.

Under Gwanghwamun Square by the King Sejong statue (its real place, OSM). Exits at the real 1, 2 and 9: exit 2 on the square north of the statue (0 m), exit 9 on the square south of it (7 m, moved off the centre walk), exit 1 on the Sejong Center pavement (10 m, moved off Sejong-daero onto the pavement).
At its real place (OSM): exits 1 and 4 moved straight out from the real ones onto Sinchon-ro's south pavement, either side of Yonsei-ro (scripts/build-sinchon.mjs).

On Yanghwa-ro at its real place: exit 9 on the Hongdae side (Hongik-ro and the walking street are a short walk south-west), exit 3 where the Gyeongui Line Forest Park starts (Yeonnam). The Airport Railroad and Gyeongui-Jungang Line also stop here; the signs show Line 2.
On Worldcup-ro at its real place (exits on both pavements, within 12 m of the real ones), a short walk from Mangwon Market.

Under Toegye-ro at the foot of the Myeongdong shopping street, at its real place (OSM station 6036160341). Exits at the real 6 and 4 (OSM 3403067532, 3403067533), moved out of Toegye-ro onto its pavements (scripts/build-myeongdong.mjs stationExits): exit 6 on the north side by Myeongdong 8-gil, the shopping street (10 m from the real one), exit 4 across the road towards Namsan and its cable car (9 m).

On Eulji-ro where Jangchungdan-ro crosses it, by the park and DDP. Lines 4 and 5 also stop here; the signs show Line 2. Exits 1 and 10 at their real places either side of Eulji-ro, moved out of the road onto the pavement (scripts/build-euljiro.mjs stationExits).

Under Jong-ro where Jibong-ro crosses it, at its real place (OSM station 9454775466). Exits at the real 3 and 4 (OSM 3401297193, 3401296590), both south of Jong-ro: exit 3 at the shrine end of the flea market, its mouth facing Dongmyo Shrine (5 m from the real one, moved off Jong-ro); exit 4 in the market's corner by Jibong-ro (5 m, moved off the roads and clear of the stalls). Line 6 also stops here; the signs show Line 1.
Teheran-ro / Yeongdong-daero corner: exit 1 on KONEXT Square, exit 2 on the south-east corner. Listed before Jamsil: on Line 2 the train goes Samseong, Sports Complex, Jamsilsaenae, Jamsil.
Songpa-daero / Olympic-ro corner. Line 8 also stops here; the signs show Line 2.

Where Olympic-ro turns north along Olympic Park and Wiryeseong-daero runs east along it, exits 1 and 2 on their real spots by the Peace Plaza. Line 9 also stops here; the signs show Line 8. Listed after Jamsil, so the train goes Jamsil -> Mongchontoseong as in real life.
Under Neungdong-ro at Children's Grand Park's main gate (exits 1 and 2 on their real spots, north and south of the gate). The real station is also named Sejong Univ.
